privacy_s1_d: We collect personal information when you register an account (name, email, password). Usage data (pages visited, reading time) is automatically collected to improve the experience.
privacy_s2_d: Your information is used to: provide services, personalize the experience, send notifications (if subscribed), and analyze usage behavior to improve the platform.
privacy_s3_d: Passwords are encrypted using Argon2id. Connections use HTTPS. We do not share personal data with third parties except as required by law.
privacy_s4_d: Selorson uses localStorage to save sessions and UI preferences. No third-party tracking cookies are used.
privacy_s5_d: You have the right to request account deletion, download personal data, and unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time.
privacy_s6_d: If you have questions about privacy, contact us via the {contact_link} or email: contact@selorson.com
terms_s1_d: By using Selorson, you agree to comply with these terms. If you do not agree, please stop using the platform.
terms_s2_d: You are responsible for the security of your account. Each person may only own one account. Violating accounts may be locked or permanently deleted.
terms_s3_d: All content on Selorson (stories, images, music, videos) belongs to the author. Copying or redistributing without consent is strictly prohibited.
terms_s4_d: Strictly prohibited: spam, harassment, hate speech, identity impersonation. Violations will result in a warning or account ban.
terms_s5_d: Comments must be constructive. We reserve the right to remove inappropriate content without prior notice.
terms_s6_d: Selorson provides services "as is". We are not responsible for service interruptions or data loss.
terms_s7_d: We reserve the right to update the terms at any time. Users will be notified via email or a platform notification.
support_welcome_title: Hello! How can we help you?
support_welcome_desc: Send a message to get started.
faq_a1: Selorson is a multimedia content platform including stories, videos, music, library, and community.
faq_q2: How do I register an account?
faq_a2: You can register with an email or login via Google. Click the "Login" button in the top right corner.
faq_a3: All chapters are free. We do not charge fees for reading stories.
faq_q4: How do I change my profile picture?
faq_a4: Go to your Profile page, click on the camera icon on the profile picture to upload a new image.
faq_q5: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq_a5: Go to the Forgot Password page (/forgot-password), enter your email and follow the instructions.
faq_a6: Selorson supports PWA and is developing native apps for iOS/Android.
faq_a7: Use the Contact page (/contact) or send an email to contact@selorson.com.
